title: Terms of Service
body:
These are the terms you agree to when you buy from Black Reaper.

Prices and stock

Prices are in US dollars and include nothing hidden. If something sells out after you order it, we tell you and refund you in full — we will not sit on your money.

Your order

An order becomes a contract once we have emailed you to say it shipped, not at the moment you click pay. If we have made an obvious pricing mistake we may cancel and refund rather than honour it, and we will say so plainly.

Using the decorations safely

These are outdoor Halloween decorations, not toys. Peg and tether anything inflatable as the instructions say. Take it down in a storm. Keep mains leads out of standing water and use an outdoor-rated socket. Children should not be left alone with any of it.

What we are responsible for

We are responsible for the product arriving as described and working. We are not responsible for damage caused by using it in a way the instructions tell you not to, or by weather beyond an ordinary autumn night.

Returns

Covered in full on our returns page, and nothing here reduces the rights the law already gives you.

Questions

Email hello@blackreaper.us.

title: Shipping
body:
Shipping is free on everything. There is no minimum and no checkout surprise — the price on the product page is the price you pay.

When it goes out

Anything shown as in stock leaves the same working day if you order before 2pm, and the next working day otherwise. You get a tracking link by email as soon as it ships.

Getting it before Halloween

Order by October 20 and it will be at your door before Halloween. After October 20 we cannot promise it — we will still ship fast, but the carriers get busy and the date stops being ours to guarantee.

Where we ship

We ship across the United States. We do not ship outside the US at the moment.

If something goes wrong on the way

If a parcel is late, lost or turns up damaged, email hello@blackreaper.us with your order number. We will chase the carrier ourselves and send a replacement if it comes to that. You do not have to fight anyone.

title: Returns
body:
You have 30 days from the day it arrives to send it back.

What we need

It needs to be in a condition we can resell — used for a night is fine, cut up or missing the blower is not. The original packaging helps but is not essential.

How to start one

Email hello@blackreaper.us with your order number and a line about what went wrong. We reply with a return label. You do not have to pay to post it back.

Your money back

Once it reaches us we refund the full amount to the card you paid with, usually within three working days. Your bank then takes its own few days to show it.

If it arrived broken or faulty

Send a photo with your email. We will ship a replacement straight away — we will not make you post the broken one back first.

After 30 days

If something fails after the 30 days are up, still email us. Anything that broke by itself rather than by accident we will sort out.

title: Contact
body:
A real person reads this inbox and replies most days, usually the same day.

Email

hello@blackreaper.us

What to include

Your order number if you have one. If something arrived damaged, a photo saves us both an email.

What we can help with

Where your order is, starting a return, something that arrived broken, whether a thing will fit your lawn, and which of them work well together.

title: Privacy Policy
body:
This explains what we collect when you buy from Black Reaper, why, and what you can ask us to do about it.

What we collect

  • When you order: your name, email, delivery address and what you bought. We need all of it to send you the thing.
  • Your payment details: handled entirely by our payment processor. Your full card number never reaches our servers and we could not see it if we wanted to.
  • When you browse: which pages you looked at, roughly where in the world you are, and what kind of device you used.

Why we collect it

To take the order, ship it, answer your emails about it, and to work out which of our ads are worth paying for. That is the whole list.

Who else sees it

Our payment processor, so you can pay. The carrier, so it can be delivered. Our email provider, so you get your receipt and tracking. Advertising platforms, for measuring ads. Nobody buys your details from us, because we do not sell them.

Cookies and ad measurement

We use cookies to keep your cart working between pages and to measure our advertising. You can block cookies in your browser; the cart is the part that will stop working if you do.

How long we keep it

Order records stay with us as long as tax rules require. Everything else we drop when it stops being useful.

What you can ask for

Email hello@blackreaper.us and you can ask us for a copy of what we hold on you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. We will not make it difficult.
